title: The Man Who Ran from God
reflectionQuestion: Have you ever known exactly what you were supposed to do — and done the opposite?
reflectionText: Running from something you have been asked to do is not always dramatic. Sometimes it looks like buying a ticket, boarding a ship, and going to sleep. Jonah did not argue or negotiate — he simply left. And then he said: throw me in. What is it to know, the whole time, exactly what you are running from?

scriptureKeyVerse.text: He said to them, “I am a Hebrew, and I fear Yahweh, the God of heaven, who has made the sea and the dry land.”
